name: phase_01_audit_persistence
lock_risk: Creates one empty append-only audit table and two indexes; it does not rewrite or lock an existing product table.
representative_data: Runs after the empty Identity schema on an empty and a version-three database before deterministic synthetic audit facts are loaded.
query_plan_review: Tenant and global-scope time-ordered indexes cover the later controlled audit read paths; no data-reading or data-rewriting statement exists.
space_risk: One empty audit fact table and two bounded supporting indexes only.
forward_fix: Add a new ordered migration for every correction after release; preserve version four and its checksum.
rollback: After release, never delete audit facts or rewrite this migration; correct behavior with an additive reviewed forward fix.
